latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of create-pptx: generate PowerPoint (PPTX) presentations using python-pptx.
- Supports timelines, charts, diagrams, custom slide layouts, themes, colors, shapes, connectors, text formatting, and transitions.
- Includes helpers for common drawing tasks and guides on EMU units, slide planning, and WPS compatibility.
- Provides template assets (business dark, education) and references for patterns, charts, standard slides, and WPS issues.
- Workflow designed for multi-slide progressive reveals to ensure full compatibility with WPS.
